education.heading: A better approach to wall assembly
education.body: BTRboard (Better Thermal Resistance) is an insulated wall sheathing product that combines OSB, fire-resistant OSB, or Type X exterior gypsum sheathing with a low-absorption thermoset foam core. By eliminating extra layers and simplifying installation, we help streamline construction while reducing material usage and labour costs for your team.
education.statement: BTRboard works harder, so you can build smarter. We help you simplify the wall assembly while improving the performance of every {Company Name} home.

benefits.heading: BTRboard Resistance
benefits.body: Increases a wall systems R-Value by up to 8.75.

benefits.heading: BTRboard Health
benefits.body: Keeps walls warm and dry to reduce condensation and mould growth.

benefits.heading: BTRboard Insulation
benefits.body: Enhances comfort by minimizing heat loss for a more consistent indoor temperature.

benefits.heading: BTRboard Energy
benefits.body: Reduces a home’s carbon footprint through lower energy use.

jayman_video.heading: Built by builders. Trusted by builders.
jayman_video.body: Don’t just take our word for it. Hear from Jay Westman, 28-time Alberta Builder of the Year, on how BTRboard is helping shape the future of homebuilding.
